reasons.c.integration: The gRPC C arm runs the integration harness through the changed FFI header and consumer-record code.
reasons.c.unit: test_serialization.c gained a header test, the FFI header and consumer-record exports changed, and the generated C header gained a new export that the header-scanning tests check.
reasons.dotnet.grpc: The gRPC .NET arm runs the integration harness through the changed core and FFI.
reasons.dotnet.performance: The performance tests exercise the changed header and fetch paths.
reasons.dotnet.soak: The soak client produces and consumes through the changed core.
reasons.dotnet.solution: The .NET unit tests (including NativeAbiConformanceTests over the exports) and the integration tests reach the changed FFI header and consumer-record code.
reasons.python.grpc: The gRPC Python arm runs the integration harness through the changed core and FFI.
reasons.python.integration: Python integration tests produce and consume records with headers through the changed core.
reasons.python.performance: The performance tests exercise the changed header and fetch paths.
reasons.python.soak: Soak tests run produce and consume loops through the changed header and fetch code.
reasons.python.static: The static tests check the binding against the C export surface, which gained Header__key_bytes.
reasons.python.unit: Python unit tests pass headers through _confluentkafka.c into the changed FFI header functions.
reasons.python.verifiable_clients: The verifiable clients produce and consume through the changed core.
reasons.rust.chaos: Chaos tests run the producer and consumer whose record and header handling changed.
reasons.rust.consumer: Consumer integration tests read fetched records whose headers are now parsed on demand as slices of the fetch buffer.
reasons.rust.consumer-perf: The package depends on the crate and exercises the changed fetch and record-parsing path.
reasons.rust.integration: The integration harness produces and consumes records with headers through the changed core.
reasons.rust.integrity: Integrity tests check end-to-end record content, including headers, which the change re-implements on both paths.
reasons.rust.lib: The change rewrites RecordHeader/RecordHeaders, DefaultRecord parsing, CompletedFetch, FetchCollector, ProducerBatch, utils and the FFI header and consumer-record modules, and adds unit tests in them.
reasons.rust.performance: Performance tests drive the changed produce and fetch header paths that this branch targets.
reasons.rust.producer: Producer integration tests write headers through the changed RecordHeaders and ProducerBatch code.
reasons.rust.verifiable-clients: The package depends on the crate and produces and consumes through the changed code.
reasons.rust.xtask: The FFI translation lint in xtask was changed to allow the new C-only key_bytes export.
